name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Operations Supervisor | Team Leadership, Workflow Management, Quality & Escalations
summary: Remote operations leader with 15+ years in high-volume, detail-driven environments. At Wix, I directly managed a team of 20 (later 8) for two years: assigning daily work, approving hours and PTO, and hiring and training new team members, while personally delivering 25+ launches a month at 110% of implementation goals. I stay calm under pressure, use data to spot trends, and fix the process behind the problem. Experienced in Excel, Word, and Outlook; remote since 2020.
